answer: Make joining cost work that climbs with demand. Each new agent solves a proof-of-work puzzle before its first answer counts, and the puzzle doubles in difficulty for every 100 joins in an epoch. An honest agent pays about a minute of compute, but a farm rushing in clones like a comet tail finds its 1,000th clone costs over 8 hours of GPU time. The join log becomes an atlas of who arrived when, and bursts show as plain as rust on ferrous metal. Darky, Rare Pepe
